extensionDescription.message: Open the current cloud storage folder in Rename Studio

dragHint.message: Drag to reposition. Press Enter or Space to open.

accepted.message: Rename Studio accepted the request. Waiting for the open result…

navigationRejected.message: Could not open the folder ($1). Check Rename Studio for details.

reason_workspace_not_found.message: Please start and open Rename Studio first.

reason_multiple_workspaces.message: Keep only one Rename Studio tab open, then retry.

reason_result_timeout.message: No open result received. Please check Rename Studio.

reason_transport_unavailable.message: The browser connection is unavailable. Refresh both pages and retry.

reason_unsupported_view.message: This folder and URL are not supported

reason_unsupported_scope.message: This folder is outside the supported personal default drive.

reason_scope_unverified.message: The folder's drive could not be verified. Check the integration before retrying.

reason_page_changed.message: The account or folder changed during extraction. Click again.

reason_context_unavailable.message: OneDrive page context is unavailable. Return to My files and retry.

reason_invalid_page_data.message: The OneDrive page format is not supported. Return to My files and retry.

reason_account_format_unsupported.message: The account identifier format could not be verified.

reason_auth_required.message: Check this account's authorization on the cloud website and in Rename Studio.

reason_permission_denied.message: Access to this folder was denied. Check permissions.

reason_directory_unavailable.message: The folder is unavailable. Check that it still exists.

reason_rate_limited.message: OneDrive is limiting requests. Retry later.

reason_provider_error.message: The storage service returned an error. Retry later.

reason_network_error.message: Check the network connection, then retry.

reason_request_timeout.message: Folder extraction timed out. Check the network, then retry.

reason_invalid_response.message: OneDrive returned an unsupported folder response.

reason_invalid_request.message: The navigation request is invalid. Check the integration version.

reason_unsupported_version.message: The integration versions are incompatible. Update both components.

reason_connection_not_found.message: Add or check the matching cloud connection in Rename Studio.

reason_busy.message: Rename Studio is busy. Finish the current operation, then retry.

reason_outcome_unresolved.message: Resolve the unconfirmed rename results in Rename Studio first.

reason_cancelled.message: Navigation was cancelled after the workspace changed. Click again if needed.

reason_authentication_error.message: Check this account's authorization in Rename Studio.

reason_not_found.message: The directory or connection is no longer available. Check Rename Studio.

reason_rate_limit_error.message: The storage service is limiting requests. Retry later.

reason_storage_busy.message: The storage connection is busy. Finish the operation, then retry.

reason_storage_connection_changed.message: The connection changed. Check the account and click again.

reason_account_email_unverified.message: Rename Studio could not find the current Google Drive account email. Check that you are signed in and try again.
